test_samplesheet_gse133774

Source: R/util_data.R
test_samplesheet_gse133774.Rd

Sample sheet for test_signal_gse133774 in the canonical SEMseeker three-class design (Reference / Control / Case).

Usage

test_samplesheet_gse133774

Format

A data frame with 16 rows and 2 columns:

Sample_ID

Sample identifier matching column names of test_signal_gse133774 (e.g. "CTRL01", "L1").

Sample_Group

One of "Reference", "Control", or "Case".

Source

Derived from GEO accession GSE133774 metadata.

Details

Control samples (CTRL01–CTRL06) appear twice: once as Reference (population baseline for IQR threshold estimation) and once as Control (comparison group). Family samples (L1–L4) are Case; L1 is the BWS proband. This is the Reference-reuse pattern documented in the getting-started vignette.
